ai_summary.text:
CIJは独立系のシステム開発会社。金融・流通・通信業界向けのシステム開発に加え、組込みソフトウェア開発、AI・IoTソリューションを手がけている。横浜を拠点に事業を展開。

売上269億円（前年比+4.5%）、営業利益22億円（営業利益率8.1%）、純利益15億円。金融系・組込みシステムの安定受注で8%の営業利益率を確保しており、DX案件の増加が業績を下支えしている。ROE10.3%と良好な資本効率。

自己資本比率77.7%、財務健全性スコア93点と堅実な財務。営業CF18億円、FCF9億円と安定したキャッシュ創出。EPS26円に対しPER18.4倍、配当15円で配当性向は約57%。DX投資の拡大と組込みシステムの高度化が事業成長の追い風であり、AI・IoT領域への展開が次の成長フェーズを見据えた布石となっている。なお、EPS26.1円、PER18.4倍、1株当たり配当金15.0円の水準にあり、株主還元と企業価値の向上を両立させる経営を推進している
ai_summary.text_en: CIJ is an independent system development company. In addition to system development for the financial, distribution, and telecommunications industries, it handles embedded software development and AI/IoT solutions. It develops its business based in Yokohama.  Sales were  26.9 billion (up 4.5% year-on-year), operating profit was  2.2 billion (operating profit margin was 8.1%), and net profit was  1.5 billion. It secures an operating profit margin of 8% with stable orders for financial and embedded systems, and the increase in DX projects is supporting earnings. Good capital efficiency with ROE of 10.3%.  Equity ratio of 77.7% and financial soundness score of 93 points, indicating solid finances. Stable cash generation with operating CF of  1.8 billion and FCF of  900 million. With EPS of  26 and a PER of 18.4x, and dividends of  15, the dividend payout ratio is approximately 57%. The expansion of DX investment and the sophistication of embedded systems are tailwinds for business growth, and the expansion into the AI/IoT field is a stepping stone for the next growth phase. The EPS is at  26.1, PER at 18.4x, and dividends per share at  15.0, promoting management that balances shareholder returns and corporate value enhancement.
